description: This file defines an abstract builder class for constructing instances of DittoRuntimeException. It provides a fluent API to set headers, message, description, cause, and href, and includes logic to build the exception object implementing the builder pattern. The class is designed to be extended for concrete exception types.

classes.name: DittoRuntimeExceptionBuilder
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing a fluent builder pattern for creating instances of DittoRuntimeException, allowing customization of headers, message, description, cause, and href before building the exception.

methods.name: dittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the exception to be built.

methods.name: message (Supplier)
methods.description: Sets the exception message using a supplier.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Sets a detailed description of the exception.

methods.name: description (Supplier)
methods.description: Sets the description using a supplier.

methods.name: cause
methods.description: Sets the cause of the exception.

methods.name: cause (Supplier)
methods.description: Sets the cause using a supplier.

methods.name: href
methods.description: Sets the hyperlink to further info as a string. Parses into URI.

methods.name: href (URI)
methods.description: Sets the hyperlink directly as a URI.

methods.name: href (Supplier)
methods.description: Sets the hyperlink using a supplier of URI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the exception object using the accumulated data.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to create specific exception instances.

methods.name: loadJson
methods.description: Deprecated method to initialize builder fields from a JSON object, matching specific JSON fields.
